title: receiveTypingIndicators missing from Chat/query filter properties
description: Chat/query filter properties include 'muted (Boolean)' but do not include receiveTypingIndicators. This is an inconsistency: muted is filterable so clients can enumerate muted chats, but there is no equivalent way to query all chats where typing indicator delivery has been suppressed. The use case is directly parallel — a settings screen listing all chats with non-default preferences would need both filters. If muted is in the filter set, receiveTypingIndicators should be too, or there should be a documented reason for the asymmetry.
close_reason: Fixed in review fix wave or recorded as accepted design decision.
